messages.subject: Trouble with addCircle
parts:
I'm having trouble plotting circles on a map.  I have 3 sets of data.  Each one I'm plotting with an addCircle in a different color.  They all technically are plotting without errors, however not all of them can be seen....  If you zoom in and out sometimes you can see the missing ones flash and the disappear.  If I change the order that the addCircle commands are called, a different one will go missing. Has anyone else had this problem or have an idea for how to fix it?

Thanks!
